testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/shopping-cart/verify-amount-off-order-promotion-functionality.spec.ts > Webstore - Shopping Cart > verify amount off order promotion functionality

scenario.summary: A guest adds two products at quantity 1 and checks that an automatic Amount Off Order promotion gives no discount below the order minimum, then raises both lines until the subtotal crosses the minimum and checks the discount label, a flat discount of at least the promotion's amount, and order total = subtotal - discount. No order is placed.
steps: Guest (empty storage state): empty the cart, add sku1 and sku2 at quantity 1, open the cart (2 lines)
Check there is no discount (below the minimum)
Find both lines by name (name1, name2) and raise each to updatedQuantity, reloading the cart after each change
Check both quantities and the 'Discount (On Sub Total)' label
Read subtotal, discount, order total: order total = subtotal - discount; discount >= the recorded flat amount (warn when it differs: tiered promotion)
Empty the cart and check the empty-cart message
stateChanges: Guest cart: two products added, quantities raised, emptied at cleanup
The promotion is only read; no order is placed
assertions: No discount with both products at quantity 1
Discount label visible with text 'Discount (On Sub Total)'
Order total close to subtotal - discount (precision 2)
evidence: Title: 'verify amount off order promotion functionality'; spec note: AUTO amount-off-ORDER promotion, guest flow, no code entered
Spec note (superseded): the promotion looked tiered on atstage (~$797 -> $45, >~$814 -> $95)

User decision 2026-10-29: the automatic Amount Off Order promotion on MaxwellsHardware is PromoAmountOffOrder (Discount 50, OrderMinimum 800, profile Anonymous; query PROMOTION_AMOUNT_OFF_ORDER, pending). The recorded $45 was the sum of two automatic $15 Amount Off Category promotions (OrderMinimum 400), not this promotion

Other automatic promotions on the store (the $15 Amount Off Category ones at $400) also discount this cart, so the migrated test must check the order-promotion discount line / the resolved promotion's discountAmount, not the cart's total discount; the quantity crossing the minimum is computed from the resolved orderMinimum
Recorded discountAmount 45.0 and updatedQuantity 3 are role data of the promotion (discountAmount; quantity computed from orderMinimum); the param discountAmount is 50.0 (PromoAmountOffOrder)
Profile: sku1 z-1234574 (MovinCool, $260 in the category spec's data) and sku2 z-2100018 (Hillman) are active simple products

User decision: the test computes quantities from the resolved promotion's orderMinimum and the cart's unit prices; products use PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK with maxPrice so the quantity-1 cart stays below the minimum

maxPrice 100 per product (cart at quantity 1 < $200, below the $800 minimum of PromoAmountOffOrder and the $400 minimum of the category promotions); sku1 at $260 cannot qualify, so it has no preferred source
quantityUsed 100: upper bound for the computed quantity (inventory headroom); the test must stay within it
ensureNoDiscountForNonSelectedProfiles is manual in the export and not migrated, so no user is needed; promotion scoped to the guest's Anonymous profile

User decision 2026-10-29 (C2d): this test IS the Anonymous order promotion (PromoAmountOffOrder 1758, orderMinimum 800): the products must be able to REACH it. Both lines are raised to qty = floor(800 / (p1 + p2)) + 1; with maxPrice 100 each (qty-1 cart < 200) that is at least 5 and up to the reserved 100 (quantityUsed 100, spec RESERVED_QUANTITY 100) -> minMaxQuantity 100 on both, so 100 x (p1 + p2) > 800 whenever p1 + p2 > 8
